rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly adornments and pleasures are animal appetites that quickly perish; attachment to them blocks inner glorification and destined perfection.
rows.anchor: وفيه إشرة إلى زينة الحياة الدنيا ومنافعها ومآكلها ومشاربها فإنها مرعى النفس الحيوانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After general guidance for creatures, God gives Muhammad special guidance: receiving revelation, retaining the Qur'an, and guiding everyone.
rows.anchor: بيان لهدايته تعالى الخاصة برسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أثر بيان هدايته العامة

rows.speaker: الراغب
rows.claim: The verse promises that God will make the Prophet unable to forget what he hears from God.
rows.anchor: أخبار وضمان من الله تعالى أن يجعله بحيث لا ينسى ما يسمعه من الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The future prefix sīn may emphasize the promise.
rows.anchor: والسين إما للتأكيد وإما لأن المراد إقراء ما أوحى إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively sīn promises recitation of both present and future revelation, hence continuing revelation.
rows.anchor: إقراء ما أوحى إليه حينئذ وما سيوحى إليه بعد ذلك فهو وعد كريم باستمرار الوحي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aqraʾa means to teach another to recite; Gabriel will convey revelation to the Prophet, who will retain it perfectly.
rows.anchor: وأقرأه غيره فهو مقرىء أي علمه إياه فهو معلم

rows.speaker: كشف الأسرار
rows.claim: God will gather Qur'anic memorization in Muhammad's heart and recitation on his tongue.
rows.anchor: سنحمع حفظ القرآن في قلبك وقراءته في لسانك حتى لا تنسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception is grammatically unrestricted over all possible objects of forgetting.
rows.anchor: استثناء مفرغ من أعم المفاعيل أي لا تنسى شيئا من الأشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading takes forgetting as permanent erasure through abrogation of recitation, from written records and memory.
rows.anchor: إلا ما شاء الله أن تنساه أبدا بأن نسخت تلاوته فإن النسخ نوع منا ساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another takes it as rare ordinary lapses followed by recall, rather than permanent forgetting.
rows.anchor: النسيان المتعارف الذي يعقبه الذكر بعده وهو النسيان في الجملة على القلة والندرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report of a verse omitted during prayer supports temporary forgetting: Ubayy thought it abrogated, but the Prophet said he forgot it.
rows.anchor: أسقط آية في قراءته في الصلاة فحسب أبي رضي الله عنه إنه نسخت فسأله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God makes Muhammad read the comprehensive realities already inscribed in his predisposition, the Qur'anic intellect; he recalls them without forgetting.
rows.anchor: لما في كتاب استعدادك الذي هو العقل القرآني من القرآن الجامع للحقائق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God may defer some realities by causing forgetfulness until Muhammad's praiseworthy station after resurrection.
rows.anchor: أن ينسيك ويذهلك عنها فيدخر للمقام المحمود إذا بعثت فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is manifest is perfection already realized in Muhammad; what is hidden is perfection still potential.
rows.anchor: ما ظهر فيك من الكمال { وما يخفى } بعد بالقوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The easy way is a lenient, simple religious law, the easiest route to God.
rows.anchor: أي: نوفقك للطريقة اليسرى أي: الشريعة السمحة السهلة التي هي أيسر الطرق إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The conjunction joins teaching and facilitation: Muhammad receives complete intellectual and practical perfection plus power to perfect others.
rows.anchor: نكملك بالكمال العلمي والعملي التام وفوق التام الذي هو التكميل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The call to perfect others benefits only those predisposed to receive admonition, even though the reminder is general.
rows.anchor: التذكير وإن كان عاما لا ينفع الخلق كلهم بل هو مشروط بشرط الاستعداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person who fears and remembers has a tender heart and sound, luminous disposition receptive to the reminder.
rows.anchor: من كان لين القلب سليم الفطرة مستعدا لقبوله يتأثر به لنوريته وصفائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The runners symbolize disciplined souls striving on God's path; spiritual effort and longing make them pant like racing horses.
rows.anchor: النفوس المجتهدة السائرة في سبيل الله التي تعدو من شدة سيرها ورياضتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their sparks are results produced when reflection combines known truths and kindles the light of the active intellect.
rows.anchor: فتوري نارا بقداح النتائج والاشتغال بنور العقل الفعال بقدح زناد النظر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At dawn of divine self-disclosure they raid and strip away wealth, bodily habits, passions, and imaginings in preparation for arrival.
rows.anchor: تغير ما يتعلق بها مما في ظواهرها وخارجها من الماليات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dust is bodily substance exhausted by ascetic discipline; the powers leave the body to follow heart and spirit toward divine lights.
rows.anchor: ونقع تراب البدن بإنهاكه وتلطيفه وتنحيفه بالرياضة ومنع الحظوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The image of raising dust also means annihilating the body until it disperses like dust.
rows.anchor: أي: أفناه وأهلكه وجعله كالغبار في التلاشي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name rewards seeking with finding, asking with praise, knowing with intimacy, and intimacy with refusal to disobey.
rows.anchor: من قصده وجده ، ومن استسعفه حمده ، من طلبه عرفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorifying the highest Lord means knowing His names and spiritually drawing praise from the jewels of His exalted realm.
rows.anchor: سبح ربك بمعرفة أسمائه ، واسبح بسرك في بحار علائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God formed each living creature's parts and arranged its organs in wondrous order.
rows.anchor: خلق كل ذي روح فسوى أجزاءه ، وركب أعضاءه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God measures each creature as intended and inspires animals to seek benefit and avoid harm.
rows.anchor: وهدى كل حيوان إلى ما فيه رشده من المنافع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guidance directs heedless people toward worldly work, worshipers toward the afterlife, and ascetics toward renouncing a perishing world.
rows.anchor: هدى قلوب الغافلين إلى طلب الدنيا فعمروها ، وهدى قلوب العابدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Scholars know God through His signs; seekers devote themselves to Him; knowers watch and witness Him; monotheists abandon everything else.
rows.anchor: وهدى قلوب العلماء إلى النظر في آياته والاستدلال بمصنوعاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ascending beyond proof, explanation, and near-vision finally teaches seekers God's inaccessibility and returns them to acknowledged incapacity.
rows.anchor: فلما ارتقوا عن حد البرهان ثم عن حد البيان ثم عما كالعيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pasture means plants; they become dry flood-debris, and aḥwā means black.
rows.anchor: جعله هشيما كالغثاء ، وهو الذي يقذفه السيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God preserves the Qur'an in Muhammad's heart so he does not forget.
rows.anchor: سنجمع القرآن في قلبك - يا محمد - حفظا حتى لا تنسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception concerns material outside the duty to transmit, which may be forgotten before proclamation.
rows.anchor: مما لا يدخل تحت التكليف فتنساه قبل التبليغ ولم يجب عليه أداؤه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows both secret and public matters.
rows.anchor: وهو - سبحانه - يعلم السر والعلن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Admonition always benefits those whom God enables to heed it; it does not benefit those destined for disbelief.
rows.anchor: والذكرى تنفع لا محالة ، ولكن لمن وفقه الله للإتعاظ بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who heed admonition fear God and His punishment.
rows.anchor: الذي يخشى الله ويخشى عقوبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wretched avoid admonition and suffer the greater fire without relief through death or pleasure in life.
rows.anchor: ثم لا يموت فيها موتا يريحه ، ولا يحيا حياة تلذ له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purification from sins, faults, and preoccupation with creation, together with almsgiving, yields salvation.
rows.anchor: من تطهر من الذنوب والعيوب ، ومشاهدة الخلق وأدى الزكاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering the Lord's name means either mentioning Him in prayer or affirming His oneness and praying to Him.
rows.anchor: ذكر اسم ربه في صلاته . ويقال : ذكره بالوحدانية وصلى له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People prefer worldly shares to God's rights, though the believers' afterlife is better and more lasting.
rows.anchor: تميلون إليها ؛ فتقدمون حظوظكم منها على حقوق الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The admonition also appears in Abraham's and Moses' earlier scriptures; monotheism, promise, and warning remain constant across laws.
rows.anchor: لأن التوحيد ، والوعد والوعيد . . . لا تختلف باختلاف الشرائع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's name requires a tongue free of idle speech and backbiting, a vigilant heart, and a spirit free of attachment and veiling.
rows.anchor: لا يصلح لذكرها إلا لسان مصون ، عن اللغو والغيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The racers are fast-running horses; ḍabḥ is a sound from their insides or their hard breathing while running.
rows.anchor: الخيل التي تعدو . { ضبحا } أي إذا ضبحن ضبحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative identifies the racers as camels.
rows.anchor: وقيل : { والعاديات } ؛ الإبل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another says God swears by the mounts of raiders.
rows.anchor: وقيل : أقسم الله بأفراس الغزاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The horses strike stones with hooves at night and raise sparks.
rows.anchor: تورى بحوافرها النار إذا عدت وأصابت سنابكها الحجارة بالليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other interpretations make the fire lighters returning warriors or spearheads.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الذين يورون النار بعد انصرافهم من الحرب . ويقال : هي الأسنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The horses attack at dawn, raise dust, and carry riders into the enemy gathering.
rows.anchor: تتوسط الخيل بفوارسها جمع العدو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human's ingratitude is the answer to the oath; kanūd means ungrateful for blessings.
rows.anchor: هذا هو جواب القسم . { لكنود } : أي لكفور بالنعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account defines the ungrateful person as seeing trials but overlooking blessings.
rows.anchor: هو الذي يرى ما إليه من البلوى ، ولا يرى ما هو به من النعمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another depicts someone resting amid blessings while the heart is heedless.
rows.anchor: هو الذي رأسه على وسادة النعمة ، وقلبه في ميدان الغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another says the ungrateful forget favors and count misfortunes.
rows.anchor: الكنود : الذي ينسى النعم ويعد المصائب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person witnesses his own ingratitude.
rows.anchor: أي : وإنه على كنوزه لشهيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively God witnesses the person's state.
rows.anchor: يحتمل : وإن الله على حاله لشهيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Love of wealth makes the person miserly.
rows.anchor: أي : وإنه لبخيل لأجل حب المال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Resurrection brings out the dead and reveals the good and evil concealed in hearts.
rows.anchor: أي : بعث الموتى . { وحصل ما فى الصدور }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will repay former deeds on that day; the concluding statement about His knowledge starts a fresh sentence.
rows.anchor: أفلا يعلم أن الله يجازيهم - ذلك اليوم - على ما أسلفوا

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Junayd takes the promise against forgetting as a command not to neglect acting on the revelation; the grammarian Ibn Kaysān admired the answer.
rows.anchor: قال الجنيد رحمه الله : لا تنسى العمل به فاعجب ابن كيسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idioms glorify your Lord's name and glorify with your Lord's name are both attested Arabic.
rows.anchor: سبح اسم ربك (1) ، و «باسم ربك » . كل ذلك قد جاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God measures His creatures and guides male animals to females.
rows.anchor: قدر خلقه فهدى الذكر لمأتى الأنثى من البهائم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative supplies implicit misguidance alongside guidance, because the two commonly occur together.
rows.anchor: قدر فهدى وأضل، فاكتفى من ذكر الضلال بذكر الهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Most readers pronounce qaddara with gemination; he prefers it for their consensus over the lighter reading.
rows.anchor: والتشديد أحب إلي لاجتماع القراء عليه

rows.speaker: أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي
rows.claim: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī read qadara without gemination; it was attributed to ʿAlī.
rows.anchor: وكان أبو عبد الرحمن السلمي يقرأ: قدر مخففة ، ويرون أنها من قراءة علي بن أبي طالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghuthāʾ is dried plant debris, and aḥwā describes blackening with age.
rows.anchor: إذا صار النبت يبيسا فهو غثاء. والأحوى: الذي قد اسود عن العتق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively aḥwā modifies the pasture first brought forth, with the word order understood as transposed.
rows.anchor: أخرج المرعى أحوى، فجعله غثاء، فيكون مؤخرا معناه التقديم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception reserves divine power without implying actual forgetting; God did not will Muhammad to forget any revelation.
rows.anchor: لم يشأ أن ينسى شيئا، وهو كقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinary oaths likewise allow 'unless I wish otherwise' while the promiser intends full performance.
rows.anchor: وعلى هذا مجاري الإيمان يستثنى فيها. ونية الحالف التمام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wretched avoid the reminder; the greater fire is the lowest layer of hell.
rows.anchor: يتجنب الذكرى فلا يذكر. وقوله جل وعز: النار الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Purification can mean doing good and giving charity, or specifically giving charity before the festival prayer.
rows.anchor: عمل بالخير وتصدق، ويقال: قد أفلح من تزكى: تصدق قبل خروجه يوم العيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer here means attending the prayer with the imam.
rows.anchor: شهد الصلاة مع الإمام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Readers agree on second-person tuʾthirūn; Ubayy's version explicitly says 'you', while some read third-person yuʾthirūn.
rows.anchor: اجتمع القراء على التاء، وهي في قراءة أبي: «بل أنتم تؤثرون الحياة»

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier scriptures contain the teaching that remembering God, praying, and doing good bring success.
rows.anchor: من ذكر اسم ربه فصلى وعمل بالخير، فهو في الصحف الأولى
